items.summary: Seattle hosts New England at Lumen Field on Wednesday 9 September at 8:20 p.m. ET, the first Wednesday opener since 2012 — the league moved it a day earlier to clear room for the international game on Thursday. items.headline: Cutdown day and waivers: 1,100+ players moved, 14 teams claimed 29, Will Levis went unclaimed
items.summary: All 32 clubs cut to 53 by 30 August; more than 1,100 players were released, waived or shelved with an injury designation. The claim window closed at 1 p.m. ET on 31 August — fourteen teams claimed 29 players, Miami taking seven. Will Levis cleared waivers unclaimed after Tennessee released him. Practice squads opened at noon the same day: 16 spots, up to six of them veterans with no accrued-season limit. The 2026 waiver order follows the draft order, so Las Vegas had first call.
